dispositions.reason: Restored 일등 공신 as the war’s foremost meritorious contributor instead of the person responsible for causing it.
Restored the Three Paths Sect as a three-sect union, Gunggwimun’s ongoing cliff archery, and the small and mid-sized Five Gates turning at once.
Rendered 웬 놈이냐 as rude identification in both the spoken line and the later overheard quotation.
Kept the joke on the curse itself being new to the Head Elder, separate from the family-hierarchy shock.
Named the Mute Acupoint and Paralysis Acupoint as the mechanisms for silence and lockup.
